verdict.rationale: First-party POS feature docs say Sidekick, Shopify's AI assistant, gives reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality. They also say it recommends stock transfers between locations based on performance trends and can create those transfers automatically. Both are AI-generated suggestions drawn from the merchant's own data. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights beyond inventory (e.g., sales or customer analysis), clarity on whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app itself or only in Shopify admin, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
